LanguageData.SSC_RomanceLog_Command.rulePack.rulesStr: ssc_romance_log_command_romance_accepted->Guided by the chain, [INITIATOR_nameDef] successfully courted [RECIPIENT_nameDef], and they became lovers.
ssc_romance_log_command_romance_rejected->Guided by the chain, [INITIATOR_nameDef] courted [RECIPIENT_nameDef], but was turned down.
ssc_romance_log_command_proposal_accepted->Guided by the chain, [INITIATOR_nameDef] proposed to [RECIPIENT_nameDef]; the proposal was accepted, and they became engaged.
ssc_romance_log_command_proposal_rejected->Guided by the chain, [INITIATOR_nameDef] proposed to [RECIPIENT_nameDef], but was refused; they remained lovers.
ssc_romance_log_command_proposal_rejected_separated->Guided by the chain, [INITIATOR_nameDef] proposed to [RECIPIENT_nameDef], but was refused, and they broke up.
ssc_romance_log_command_end_lover->At the chain's command, [INITIATOR_nameDef] ended the lover relationship with [RECIPIENT_nameDef].
ssc_romance_log_command_end_fiance->At the chain's command, [INITIATOR_nameDef] ended the engagement to [RECIPIENT_nameDef].
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceLog_Reject.rulePack.rulesStri: ssc_romance_log_reject_romance->Under the chain's control, [RECIPIENT_nameDef] refused [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s courtship.
ssc_romance_log_reject_proposal->Under the chain's control, [RECIPIENT_nameDef] refused [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s proposal.
ssc_romance_log_reject_proposal_separated->Under the chain's control, [RECIPIENT_nameDef] refused [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s proposal and ended their lover relationship.
LanguageData.SSC_RomanceLog_Accept.rulePack.rulesStri: ssc_romance_log_accept_romance->Under the chain's control, [RECIPIENT_nameDef] accepted [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s courtship, burning all over, and they became lovers.
ssc_romance_log_accept_proposal->Under the chain's control, [RECIPIENT_nameDef] accepted [INITIATOR_nameDef]'s proposal, burning all over, and they became engaged.
